title: CHAPTER NINE. The resurrection of the dead is proved possible from natural principles; five heads follow
pass_a_gloss: there follow the better ones, who rightly and firmly assert (1) that it stands as possible, (2) that it stands as certainly future, (3) its causes, (4) its mode, (5) its necessary consequence. These things touching those who wrongly denied the resurrection belonging toward the flesh: The resurrection belonging toward the dead stands as proved to be possible from natural principles. CHAPTER NINE.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER NINE. The resurrection of the dead is proved to be possible from natural principles.

These things concerning those who wrongly denied the resurrection of the flesh: there follow the better ones, who rightly and firmly assert (1) that it is possible, (2) that it is certainly future, (3) its causes, (4) its mode, (5) its necessary consequence.
source_text: CAPUT NONUM, Resurrectionem mortuorum possibilem esse, principiis naturalibus probatur. Haec de iis qui resurrectionem carnis perperam negaverunt: sequuntur meliores, qui recte firmiterque asserunt, eam 1. esse possibilem, 2. certo futuram, 3. ejus causas, 4. modum, 5. necessarium consequens.
